verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of handling many items at once is webhook queueing: a scenario can be scheduled so that the whole queue of webhook requests is processed each time the schedule criteria are met. The API also exposes collection retrieval, such as listing all connections for a team. Neither amounts to documented bulk create, update or delete across many items. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, iterator/aggregator-style bulk processing inside scenarios, bulk operations exposed via MCP tools for AI clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
